title: Buchanan bilocates to Cydonia on Mars, later matched to a photo at Puthoff's
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Buchanan bilocates to Cydonia on Mars, later matched to a photo at Puthoff's, about present-day Mars at Cydonia region, Mars; California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And uh the first time that happened to me was with the Sedona region at Mars.

plain: Lyn Buchanan is a former Army sergeant who worked in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe faraway places using only the mind. He says the first time he "bilocated", meaning he felt he was really present somewhere else, he found himself in Cydonia, a region of Mars. According to Buchanan, what he saw was later matched to a photograph he came across at the California home of a man named Puthoff, which would mean the mind can reach other planets if it were true.
